metadata.description: Agent Skills for Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning checks: build, review, test, debug, deploy, and validate AR policies.

plugins.name: ar-policy-builder
plugins.description: Create an Automated Reasoning policy from a source document (INGEST_CONTENT).

plugins.name: ar-policy-reviewer
plugins.description: Inspect a policy's quality + fidelity reports and produce a prioritized fix list.

plugins.name: ar-policy-tester
plugins.description: Generate scenarios and run QnA tests against an AR policy.

plugins.name: ar-policy-debugger
plugins.description: Diagnose failing tests and repair policies via annotations / refinement workflows.

plugins.name: ar-guardrail-deployer
plugins.description: Version a policy and attach it to a Bedrock Guardrail for production.

plugins.name: ar-runtime-validator
plugins.description: Validate LLM outputs with ApplyGuardrail and run an iterative rewrite loop (Valid@N).
